newsitem.title: ITALY: Employers give guarded welcome to Italy rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Employers give guarded welcome to Italy rate cut.

text.p: Italian employers' federation Confindustria on Friday welcomed the Bank of Italy's decision to cut its key discount rate to 6.25 percent from 6.75 percent, taking interest rates to their lowest level in 22 years.
But the group, which had been vociferous in calling for a rate cut, said Italian interest rates were still too high.

"Private industry had been waiting a long time for this cut which confirms the anti-inflationistic efforts of the productive system and partly alleviates a financial burden," Confindustria said in a statement.
"Still, the cost of money remains higher than in other countries. We therefore hope that further rate cuts follow in coming months," Confindustria added.
It urged the government to make structural reforms to Italy's bloated welfare system, calling them a "necessary condition" for further rate cuts. -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2505
